name: Re-enactor Nicola

intro.text: I play Nicola de la Haye, who held Lincoln Castle twice against sieges, and was made Sheriff of Lincolnshire in 1216, in her sixties. A woman sheriff, eight hundred years ago.
She didn't give up the castle. I won't give up this battle.

win: Yielded! The castle's yours, for today. Nicola would have made you swear an oath first.
after: In 1217 the Second Battle of Lincoln was fought right here in the streets, and Nicola's castle held. The French prince's army was routed, and Magna Carta was reissued that year.
